Hi Naomi —

Thanks for sending. This looks helpful. Two immediate items from procurement/legal:

1) Our legal team (Alan copied) needs the DPA draft and a short note on whether the DPA includes subprocessors / EU transfers — we expect US-only but need explicit confirmation.
2) We require SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent evidence for the past 12 months. If you can't provide the full report ahead of signature, an attestation + stub evidence to cover the pilot is acceptable with a plan to share the full report before production go-live.

We also want to align the MAP acceptance criteria with specific test cases (pass/fail) — your EvalPlan spreadsheet will help.

Proposed next step: internal review + 30-minute sync with legal & procurement next Tue (7/14). Does that work for your team?

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nectara — pre-send: dependency register & MAP for procurement

Naomi / Rishi —

Quick legal note from our side after an initial scan of the MAP: we have two redline topics that will affect sequencing:

A) DPA scoping: Nectara requires processor-level commitments including subprocessors list and a right to audit clause. If Redwood can provide an addendum that scopes subprocessors for the pilot (or an audit-friendly attestation), we can treat the DPA as a pilot gating item; otherwise we must make DPA execution required before any data ingestion.

B) Liability / indemnity buckets: their procurement will push for a 1x-3x cap tied to fees; if Redwood wants to retain current limits we need to propose compensating controls (e.g., production-only data segregation and SRE runbooks) that procurement can sign off on.

For sequencing: we prefer (1) a Letter DPA for pilot + attestation and SOC2 stub, (2) full DPA and finalized MSA before production, (3) order form signed to trigger billing milestones aligned to acceptance gates.

If you can send the DPA redlines and a suggested sequence we can be ready for Tue's sync.

—Alan
Alan Cho
Senior Counsel, Nectara AI
alan.cho@nectara.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procure@nectara.ai>, Alan Cho <alan.cho@nectara.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nectara — pre-send: dependency register & MAP for procurement

Thanks Alan —

Appreciate the clarity. To be explicit about Redwood's proposed sequencing and controls:

1) Pilot start (non-production data): sign a short Letter DPA that enumerates subprocessors in-scope for the pilot. We will provide a subprocessors spreadsheet and an attestation that those subprocessors are under contract.
2) SOC2: we can provide a SOC2 Type II summary + evidence stub now (attached: SOC2-evidence-stub.txt) and commit to delivering the full report under NDA by production cutover.
3) MSA: we'll aim to finalize the MSA redlines before production. For the pilot we can operate under a mutually-signed Statement of Work (order form) that references the in-flight MSA and includes the 30/60/90 payment milestone language tied to acceptance gates documented in the MAP.

We propose a single 30-min sync today at 3pm PT to walk the MAP acceptance tests and the minimal DPA content to unblock pilot. If that works for you, I will send an invite.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-stub.txt

Rishi / Naomi —

Thanks for the call earlier. This captures what we agreed:

- Letter DPA to be signed this week (pilot scope + subprocessors list).
- Redwood to deliver SOC2 summary + evidence stub today; full SOC2 under NDA before production.
- Order form to be countersigned with payment milestones mapped to acceptance gates; MSA redlines to be finalized within two weeks of pilot kick-off.

Action items assigned:
- Naomi: upload final MAP PDF with the acceptance criteria numbered (we want exact pass/fail mapping).
- Rishi: send the Letter DPA draft and subprocessors list for Alan to review.
- Marissa / Priya (Redwood): support onboarding runbooks and SRE checklist for indemnity compensating controls.

We expect legal sign-off on the Letter DPA once Alan confirms the subprocessors list. After that, procurement will proceed to countersign the order form and schedule the onboarding window.

Looking forward to the pilot.

Maya Singh
